text:
Maya G: FYI starting a short async sync on the LumosHealth trial deliverables. Goal: confirm owners and target dates for the three integration asks (webhooks, embeddings, SSO) and any immediate blockers.
Cheng Li: I can own infra + sandbox VPC setup. ETA Wed EOD next week. Need Lumos' subnet/IP allowlist and their firewall contact.
Samir N: I'll own embeddings pipeline + evals. Question: which model tier do they want for the POC? They asked for 'high accuracy' in the notes — likely 8k context. Also need token budget for eval runs.
Devon (SE): Success criteria draft from our side: 1) median latency <300ms for short prompts, 2) webhook delivery success >=95% within 10s, 3) embedding recall >=0.78 on our eval set. Lumos also asked for PII redaction in outputs.
Maya G: @Cheng Li can you confirm KMS/HSM availability for the sandbox? They want keys isolated per-customer. Need a dedicated sandbox key if possible.
Cheng Li: We can provision a customer-specific KMS key in the private sandbox. Need a JIRA ticket + SOC approval for key access. I've flagged infra-compliance.
Samir N: For embeddings I'll run two model profiles: redwood/opt-4k-q4 (fast/cost) and redwood/opt-8k-q8 (accuracy). Plan to run a small eval suite by Fri. Can someone drop the sample dataset into the shared folder?
Maya G: Uploaded a trimmed sample set to /shared/pocs/lumos (Google Drive). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleLink (placeholder).
Devon (SE): Webhook details: Lumos expects guaranteed delivery semantics. We'll sign payloads with HMAC-SHA256. Example curl for verification: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.lumos.dev/receive -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-RW-Signature: sha256=<sig>' -d '{"id":"evt_123","type":"response.hook"}'```
infra-bot: Deploy job #492 queued: sandbox VPC + initial routing rules. Estimated completion: ~2h.
Cheng Li: One blocker: Lumos currently uses static NAT ranges that require a firewall rule on their side. @Maya G can you get their security contact and a sample allowlist?
Maya G: Looping in Lumos: @Lisa (Lumos) can you share the firewall contacts + preferred model tier? Also confirming target demo date — proposing Tue 2026-04-07 for customer-facing demo.
Lisa (Lumos): Thanks Maya. We'll provide the firewall list by EOD tomorrow. For the model tier, we prefer accuracy > cost for the pilot, so go ahead with the 8k profile. We'll review the evals once you send them.
Devon (SE): Good — I'll assemble the deliverables checklist and post it here tomorrow morning. Planned items: webhook test harness + runbook, embeddings eval report, SSO/IdP guide, perf/latency report, rollout notes.
Samir N: Noted. I'll kick off eval runs once the sample set is confirmed and will post a short summary with precision/recall + throughput by Fri.
Cheng Li: After infra completes, I'll share VPC endpoints and the sandbox service URL. Also confirm: do we need to enable prefix caching for this trial? Could help latency.
Maya G: Prefix caching sounds fine for demo — Samir, any objections?
Samir N: No objections, enable it. I'll account for cache effects in the eval.
Devon (SE): Minor ask — can product provide the exact success criteria wording for the contract? Want to avoid ambiguity around "embedding recall" threshold.
Maya G: I'll draft the contract clause and ping @Legal for sign-off.
infra-bot: Deploy job #492: completed successfully. Sandbox endpoints: https://sandbox-preview.redwood.example/lumos (placeholder).
Maya G: Perfect. If we get firewall list and KMS ticket approved, we should be on track for the Tue demo. :thumbsup: Ping here if you need expedited approvals.
Cheng Li: I'll start the SOC ticket and post the JIRA link shortly.
Lisa (Lumos): We'll get the firewall and contact info by tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
